title: Olife protocol codecs
creator: olife
description: Generated codecs of the Olife protocol (contracts client, internal, sandbox) — tools/olife/gen_codecs.py from tools/olife/protocol/*.yaml. Library pack used by olife_world and olife_client. Hand-written shared modules: movement.lua (deterministic player movement for prediction), items.lua (inventory helpers), looks.lua (models/textures an owner may pick, UX round 1). No items of its own (the test coin was removed in UX round 1).
